subject: GCP Marketplace listing & procurement workflow – AtlasData kickoff
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@atlasdata.com>, AtlasData Procurement <procurement@atlasdata.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: GCP Marketplace listing & procurement workflow – AtlasData kickoff

Hi Nina / AtlasData procurement team,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the GCP Marketplace path for AtlasData. I wanted to capture a short agenda and immediate asks so we have a clear procurement handoff and listing timeline.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30 min):
- Introductions & roles (Redwood / Atlas)
- Listing model: private listing vs. public SaaS on GCP
- Procurement requirements: PO terms, invoicing cadence, tax form needs (W-8/W-9)
- Contracting timeline and redline owner (legal vs. procurement)
- Next steps & milestones (pricing approval, DocuSign, GCP seller onboarding)

Immediate asks from your team: 
1) Confirm who will sign the Master Subscription Agreement (legal contact + procurement).
2) Supply procurement questionnaire and any internal supplier IDs we should reference.
3) Estimated time-to-PO once pricing is agreed (typical range is 2–6 weeks).

Attached: Redwood GCP listing checklist (high-level), first-pass pricing PDF.

I can run a 30-minute sync early next week if that works for you — propose Mon 12/1 10:00–10:30 PT or Tue 12/2 9:00–9:30 PT.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_gcp_listing_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: RDW_AtlasData_pricing_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Nina Patel <nina@atlasdata.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: AtlasData Procurement <procurement@atlasdata.com>, Michael Chu <michael.chu@atlasedge.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing & procurement workflow – AtlasData kickoff

Diego,

Thanks for the clear agenda — that works. A few quick answers from procurement: 

- Signer: Legal/Contracts will sign MSAs; procurement will handle PO issuance. Our legal contact is Michael Chu (cc'd).
- Questionnaire: Attached is our standard supplier onboarding questionnaire (merchant_tax / banking / compliance sections). Please complete the highlighted fields and return.
- PO lead time: For new vendors with standard T&Cs we typically take 3–5 weeks; if legal redlines are required, factor in additional 1–2 weeks.

A couple of items we need from Redwood before the sync:
- Final pricing table broken out by SKU (monthly seats / token units / reserved capacity).
- Tax ID and billing remit address for the invoice.
- SOC 2 attestation or summary of controls (a redacted report or link is fine).

We can do Tue 12/2 9:00 PT — that works for procurement and Michael.

Appreciate it,
Nina Patel
Head of Strategic Partnerships | AtlasData
[Attachment: atlas_procurement_questionnaire.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
